title: Global Temperature Trends
text:
This site visualizes how global surface temperatures have changed since 1880, using the NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4).
Values are temperature anomalies: how much warmer or cooler a period was compared with the 1951–1980 average, in degrees Celsius.

What’s inside

title: Global Temperature Trends
text:
Data source
NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies, GISS Surface Temperature Analysis. The data is downloaded each time the site is rendered, so rebuilding the site picks up NASA’s latest update.






Note



The current year is incomplete, so it has no annual (J–D) value. It is left out of the annual charts but appears in the monthly animation.
